conflicts.permit: We may have disclosed each of these categories of California Information to the following categories of third parties
conflicts.prohibit: We will not use the information gathered from your conversations for any purpose other than to provide the Services.
conflicts.situation: A California user's in-game chat, a listed category of California Information, is disclosed to Advertising Partners for advertising on the Service.
conflicts.reason: The California section lists chat or comments as collected and says each category may go to Advertising Partners, while the conversations section limits chat to providing the Services. The policy states no precedence between them.
